caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden panel with a lighter-colored inner section framed by a darker, reddish-brown wood border. The inner section is a warm, light tan or golden color, and it features a symmetrical pattern of dark brown, fern-like leaves, with the leaflets alternating along a central stem that runs vertically through the center of the panel. The wood grain is visible both in the border and the inner section. The panel itself is centered on a plain off-white background. At the lower left, there is a scale notation ("SCALE 3/8" = 1'") and at the lower right, the name "WILLIAM A. KROP" is printed.
title: Panels from Rail Car Interiors
